abbott_smith_html:
κρίνω,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁפט, also for ריב ,דּין, etc. ;]
__1. to separate, select, choose (cl.; in LXX: 2Ma.13:15).
__2. to approve, esteem: Rom.14:5.
__3. to be of opinion, judge, think: Luk.7:43, 1Co.11:13; before τοῦτο ὅτι, 2Co.5:14; with accusative and inf., Act.16:15; with accusative and pred., Act.13:46 26:8.
__4. to decide, determine, decree: with accusative, Act.16:4, Rom.14:13, 1Co.7:37, 2Co.2:1; with inf. (Field, Notes, 167), Act.20:16 25:25, 1Co.2:2 5:3, Tit.3:12 (cf. 1Ma.11:33, Wis.8:9, al.); with accusative and inf., Act.21:25 27:1.
__5. to judge, adjudge, pronounce judgment: absol., Jhn.8:16, 26; before κατά, with accusative, Jhn.7:24 8:15; κρίσιν κ., Jhn.7:24; τ. δίκαιον, Luk.12:57 (Deiss., LAE, 118); in forensic sense, Jhn.18:31, Act.23:3, al.; pass., Rom.3:4 (LXX); of God's judgment, Jhn.5:30 8:50, Rom.2:16 3:6, 2Ti.4:1, 1Pe.4:5, al.
__6. = κατακρίνω, to condemn (cl.): Act.13:27; of God's judgment, Jhn.3:18 5:22 12:47, 48, Act.7:7, Rom.2:12, 1Co.11:32, Heb.10:30" (LXX), Jas.5:9, Rev.19:2, al.
__7. As in LXX (for שׁפט), to rule, govern ( 4Ki.15:5, Psa.2:10, al.): Mat.19:28, Luk.22:30, 1Co.6:3.
__8. to bring to trial (cl.); mid., to go to law: with dative of person(s), Mat.5:40; before μετά, with genitive of person(s) (of the opponent), ἐπί, with genitive (of the judge), 1Co.6:1, 6 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἀντ-απο- (-μαι), δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συν-, ὑπο- (-μαι), συν-υπο- (-μαι)).
SYN.: see: δικάστης. (AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: by implication, to try, condemn, punish
strongs_1890.derivation: properly, to distinguish, i.e. decide (mentally or judicially);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: avenge, conclude, condemn, damn, decree, determine, esteem, judge, go to (sue at the) law, ordain, call in question, sentence to, think

lxx_note: [in LXX chiefly for שׁפט, also for ריב ,דּין, etc. ;]

occurrences.bsb: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well;
occurrences.kjv: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.

occurrences.bsb: “Do not judge, or you will be judged.
occurrences.kjv: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

occurrences.bsb: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
occurrences.kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
occurrences.kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

occurrences.bsb: “I suppose the one who was forgiven more,” Simon replied. “You have judged correctly,” Jesus said.
occurrences.kjv: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

occurrences.bsb: And why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
occurrences.kjv: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

occurrences.bsb: His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

occurrences.bsb: so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
occurrences.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
occurrences.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
occurrences.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

occurrences.bsb: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

occurrences.bsb: Stop judging by outward appearances, and start judging justly.”
occurrences.kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

occurrences.bsb: “Does our law convict a man without first hearing from him to determine what he has done?”
occurrences.kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

occurrences.bsb: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
occurrences.kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

occurrences.bsb: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

occurrences.bsb: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”
occurrences.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

occurrences.bsb: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
occurrences.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

occurrences.bsb: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

occurrences.bsb: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
occurrences.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

occurrences.bsb: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.
occurrences.kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

occurrences.bsb: “You take Him and judge Him by your own law,” Pilate told them. “We are not permitted to execute anyone,” the Jews replied.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

occurrences.bsb: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His servant Jesus. You handed Him over and rejected Him before Pilate, even though he had decided to release Him.
occurrences.kjv: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

occurrences.bsb: But Peter and John replied, “Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than God.
occurrences.kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

occurrences.bsb: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’
occurrences.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

occurrences.bsb: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning Him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.
occurrences.kjv: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: “It was necessary to speak the word of God to you first. But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
occurrences.kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

occurrences.bsb: It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not cause trouble for the Gentiles who are turning to God.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

occurrences.bsb: As they went from town to town, they delivered the decisions handed down by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem for the people to obey.
occurrences.kjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: And when she and her household had been baptized, she urged us, “If you consider me a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house.” And she persuaded us.
occurrences.kjv: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

occurrences.bsb: For He has set a day when He will judge the world with justice by the Man He has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead.”
occurrences.kjv: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

occurrences.bsb: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, because he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.
occurrences.kjv: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

occurrences.bsb: As for the Gentile believers, we have written to them our decision that they must abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals, and from sexual immorality.”
occurrences.kjv: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit here to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul, knowing that some of them were Sadducees and the others Pharisees, called out in the Sanhedrin, “Brothers, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee. It is because of my hope in the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial.”
occurrences.kjv: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.

occurrences.bsb: unless it was this one thing I called out as I stood in their presence: ‘It is concerning the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial before you today.’”
occurrences.kjv: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.

occurrences.bsb: But Festus, wishing to do the Jews a favor, said to Paul, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem to stand trial before me on these charges?”
occurrences.kjv: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?

occurrences.bsb: Paul replied, “I am standing before the judgment seat of Caesar, where I ought to be tried. I have done nothing wrong to the Jews, as you yourself know very well.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Paul, I stand at Cesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.

occurrences.bsb: Since I was at a loss as to how to investigate these matters, I asked if he was willing to go to Jerusalem and be tried there on these charges.
occurrences.kjv: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.

occurrences.bsb: But I found he had done nothing worthy of death, and since he has now appealed to the Emperor, I decided to send him.
occurrences.kjv: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.

occurrences.bsb: And now I stand on trial because of my hope in the promise that God made to our fathers,
occurrences.kjv: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:

occurrences.bsb: Why would any of you consider it incredible that God raises the dead?
occurrences.kjv: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?

occurrences.bsb: When it was decided that we would sail for Italy, Paul and some other prisoners were handed over to a centurion named Julius, who belonged to the Imperial Regiment.
occurrences.kjv: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus’ band.

occurrences.bsb: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on another. For on whatever grounds you judge the other, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

occurrences.bsb: So when you, O man, pass judgment on others, yet do the same things, do you think you will escape God’s judgment?
occurrences.kjv: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

occurrences.bsb: All who sin apart from the law will also perish apart from the law, and all who sin under the law will be judged by the law.
occurrences.kjv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

occurrences.bsb: on the day when God will judge men’s secrets through Christ Jesus, as proclaimed by my gospel.
occurrences.kjv: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

occurrences.bsb: The one who is physically uncircumcised yet keeps the law will condemn you who, even though you have the written code and circumcision, are a lawbreaker.
occurrences.kjv: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

occurrences.bsb: Certainly not! Let God be true and every man a liar. As it is written: “So that You may be proved right when You speak and victorious when You judge.”
occurrences.kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

occurrences.bsb: Certainly not! In that case, how could God judge the world?
occurrences.kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

occurrences.bsb: However, if my falsehood accentuates God’s truthfulness, to the increase of His glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?
occurrences.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

occurrences.bsb: The one who eats everything must not belittle the one who does not, and the one who does not eat everything must not judge the one who does, for God has accepted him.
occurrences.kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

occurrences.bsb: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
occurrences.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

occurrences.bsb: One person regards a certain day above the others, while someone else considers every day alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.
occurrences.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

occurrences.bsb: Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
occurrences.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore let us stop judging one another. Instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in your brother’s way.
occurrences.kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.

occurrences.bsb: Keep your belief about such matters between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.
occurrences.kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

occurrences.bsb: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
occurrences.kjv: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men’s hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of God.

occurrences.bsb: Although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I have already pronounced judgment on the one who did this, just as if I were present.
occurrences.kjv: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,

occurrences.bsb: What business of mine is it to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?
occurrences.kjv: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?

occurrences.bsb: If any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!
occurrences.kjv: Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?
occurrences.kjv: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!
occurrences.kjv: Know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life?

occurrences.bsb: Instead, one brother goes to law against another, and this in front of unbelievers!
occurrences.kjv: But brother goeth to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.

occurrences.bsb: But the man who is firmly established in his heart and under no constraint, with control over his will and resolve in his heart not to marry the virgin, he will do well.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.

occurrences.bsb: I speak to reasonable people; judge for yourselves what I say.
occurrences.kjv: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.

occurrences.bsb: the other one’s conscience, I mean, not your own. For why should my freedom be determined by someone else’s conscience?
occurrences.kjv: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?

occurrences.bsb: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
occurrences.kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

occurrences.bsb: Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.
occurrences.kjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

occurrences.bsb: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
occurrences.kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

occurrences.bsb: So I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.
occurrences.kjv: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

occurrences.bsb: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that One died for all, therefore all died.
occurrences.kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.
occurrences.kjv: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

occurrences.bsb: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.
occurrences.kjv: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

occurrences.bsb: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
occurrences.kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

occurrences.bsb: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
occurrences.kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

occurrences.bsb: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
occurrences.kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

occurrences.bsb: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
occurrences.kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

occurrences.bsb: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.
occurrences.kjv: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
occurrences.kjv: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

occurrences.bsb: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
occurrences.kjv: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?

occurrences.bsb: Do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged. Look, the Judge is standing at the door!
occurrences.kjv: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.

occurrences.bsb: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.
occurrences.kjv: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

occurrences.bsb: When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.
occurrences.kjv: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:

occurrences.bsb: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
occurrences.kjv: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

occurrences.bsb: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
occurrences.kjv: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

occurrences.bsb: And they cried out in a loud voice, “How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You judge those who dwell upon the earth and avenge our blood?”
occurrences.kjv: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

occurrences.bsb: The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great—and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
occurrences.kjv: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard the angel of the waters say: “Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.
occurrences.kjv: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore her plagues will come in one day—death and grief and famine—and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.

occurrences.bsb: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
occurrences.kjv: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.

occurrences.bsb: For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.”
occurrences.kjv: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

occurrences.bsb: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. And books were opened, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

occurrences.bsb: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead, and each one was judged according to his deeds.
occurrences.kjv: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
